card.name: Drug interaction verbs and 'the' before effect
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the' or 'with', or verbs like 'enhance' and 'reduce', right after 'may enhance/interfere/delay' in drug interaction sections. They come just before 'the effect/action/absorption of' another drug.

modes.label: 'the' after enhance
modes.description: The word 'the' straight after 'may enhance' in an interaction sentence.
modes.example: quetiapine fumarate may enhance<< the>> effects of certain antihypertensive

modes.label: 'with' after interfere
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'may interfere' before 'the action of' a drug.
modes.example: Bile acid sequestering agents, such as cholestyramine and colestipol, may interfere<< with>> the action of Chenodiol by reducing

modes.label: Change verbs
modes.description: A verb of change such as reduce, decreased or enhance in an interaction statement.
modes.example: High doses of folic acid may result in<< decreased>> serum levels of anticonvulsant

card.writes: It suppresses dose-related words like dose, dosage and medicine, so the next word is more likely an effect noun than a dose term.
card.plain: It fires in drug interaction sentences where one drug 'may enhance the effect of' or 'interfere with' another.
